B5000.scope: B5000 student head; descriptive, no endpoint gate or automatic continuation.
B5000.units: standardized squared angles for decomposition; radians for E1 MAE control
B5000.aggregation: Compute population moments per window/joint; pool with valid-element weights. Centered statistics and every component of their decomposition use only n>=2 window/joint cells.
B5000.gain_identity: On the identical n>=2 support: total_gain=(E[y^2]-MSE)=gain_mean+gain_centered; gain_mean=mean(y)^2-(mean(p)-mean(y))^2; gain_centered=var(y)-centered_MSE.
B5000.interpretation: Mean and centered gains are additive error components, not causal mechanisms. Components can be negative; no percentage attribution is imposed. Pooled-centered correlation removes each window/joint mean and contains no between-window covariance.
